testcase.name: gravity is the throwable's own, far gentler than bullet drop
state copies are independent, and the wire id lands in the utility range
bouncing keeps 0.35 of the normal component and 0.70 of the tangential one
throw velocity and muzzle offset follow the aim angle
a dropped grenade settles on the ground within a couple of seconds
step() leaves its argument alone; stepInPlace() is the allocation-free twin
a hard throw stays inside the arena instead of escaping through the ceiling
solidAt finds the surface a throwable is touching, and nothing in open air
a fast throwable is substepped so it cannot pass through the 14-unit tunnel roof
a resting throwable stays put but keeps counting down
substep count tracks speed and is capped so a tick can never stall
hitting a wall reflects X and scrubs Y, with a sideways contact normal
